# ChemInventory

> ChemInventory is a chemical inventory management system. Track chemicals, suppliers, purchasers, users and an audit log in one app.

ChemInventory (short name CIMS) is made by Junto Technologies.

## Features

- Chemical tracking: Record product numbers, CAS numbers, locations, batch details and custom fields for each chemical.
- Audit logs: Log every change with its timestamp and the user who made it.
- Supplier management: Keep supplier records, contacts and purchasing context in one place.
- Purchaser tracking: Record purchaser details, approvals and transaction history.
- User management: Set role-based access and permissions for people and departments.
- Inventory analytics: Reports, dashboards and forecasting views for inventory.
